providerName.description: The name of the provider of the account.

currency.description: The currency of the account. Defaults to GBP.

type.description: The type of account - this will determine the data available in the details field

value.description: The value of the balance in minor units of the currency, eg. pennies for GBP.

AER.description: For cash and savings accounts. Interest rate expressed as a percentage 'Annual Equivalent Rate'.

APR.description: For credit cards, mortgages and loans. Interest rate expressed as a percentage 'Annual Percentage Rate'.

creditLimit.description: For credit cards. The agreed overdraft limit of the account in minor units of the currency.

endDate.description: For Mortgages and loans. The date at which the loan/mortgage will finish.

fixedDate.description: For Mortgages. The date at which the current fixed rate ends

interestFreePeriod.description: For loans. The length in months of the interest free period

linkedProperty.description: For Mortgages. The id of an associated property account

monthlyRepayment.description: For mortgages and loans. The monthly amount due to the mortgage provider in minor units of the currency.

overdraftLimit.description: For cash accounts. The agreed overdraft limit of the account in minor units of the currency.

postcode.description: For properties. The postcode of the property

runningCost.description: For assets. The running cost in minor units of the currency.

runningCostPeriod.description: For assets. The running cost period

term.description: For mortgages. The term of the mortgage in months.

yearlyAppreciation.description: For assets. The rate of appreciation as a percentage, negative values indicate that the asset will depreciate

providerAccountIdentifications.description: List of provider specific account identifications
